description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly. Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters. KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. • Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory. • A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem. • Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research. • Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English. ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES • Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation. • Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets. HOW TO APPLY Please prepare a single PDF file containing: 1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above. 3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments. You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership. What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the Technical Program Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability. Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals. Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations. Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security. Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points. Partner with Product Management Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management. Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early. Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity. Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments. Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness. Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions. Be a Senior Technical Leader Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level. Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers. Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead. Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs. Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team. Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization. Fluent in English; German is a strong plus. High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites. Your Benefits: Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc. Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco. We’re building across three theses: Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need. This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits. AI is the buyer. Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on. Financial Services & Regulated business. Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated. We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical. WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market. Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially. It is a rare role to build category-defining companies learn how they get built, from the inside, at the frontier of AI. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned. The mission We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two: 80% - real company-building Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live. Go-to-market, your main focus: you own GTM for each company: positioning, first customers, sales, pricing, go-to-market experiments, and the tools, automations and trackers needed to run them. Hexa’s central pool covers product and design; GTM sits with you. You are part of the company and our growth depend on you. In the operational rhythm of each company: weekly kick-offs, product meetings, end-of-week recaps. You own the cadence, objectives set, notes written, decisions tracked, and leverage AI so we focus our time on building and selling not writing down plans. The founders’ first port of call on anything outside their own scope, and the interface between the ventures and the rest of Hexa (Finance, Legal, Talent, Comms), pulling in the right resource when a project needs it. 20% - studio operations How we run as a studio: keeping the machine sharp and the founder pipeline full. Discovery transforming new ideas into tangible opportunities: discovery outreach and meeting, market sizing, value chain, positioning, the opportunity note that gets a project greenlit. Growing the founder pipeline: working with the Talent team on the sourcing strategy for each new project, gathering top talent in the industry and making WTF visible to the best potential founders and ecosystem players. Building visibility: working with the brand team on Raphaël’s and the studio’s reputation. Improving how the studio (and Hexa) runs: sharpening shared AI agent and tooling (GTM ex: github repo), playbooks and best practice (ex: grokbot rollout), and reusable systems that make the studio & Hexa as a whole compound over time. Who we’re looking for. 2 to 4 years of experience as founder, go-to-market, growth, operations or even engineering in tech company/ecossystem. This is your shot to build real things, not assist. How you execute and you track executing matters more than the title on your resume. A builder. You’ve been hands-on inside an early-stage startup, or founded something yourself, and you build things: automations, tools, dashboards, experiments. A genuine go-to-market appetite: you’re not afraid to reach out cold, and you like the hands-on part of landing the first customers. You will meet real people and sell while being nobody for them. High agency. You’re the person who figures it out and ships, without waiting to be told how. Hard worker and hungry: you want to be part of building great companies, and you bring energy, hard work and rigor to it. AI nerd: you use AI tools on a daily basis and constantly test switch to better setup. Comfortable being in front of people: reaching out to founders, hosting events, representing the studio. Working in English Recruitment process First call with Louise (current GTM lead): introduction to Hexa, WTF, check on cultural fit. Interview with Raphaël: mutual introduction, deep dive into the role and how we work. Case study: an exercise inspired by our real work. description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine. Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Nice-to-have Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche. description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line Commercial AE is where incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business. What that looks like day to day This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game. You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly. We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread. What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge. AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook. The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there. Who you are You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up. Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you. You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell. You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own. You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you. You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon. Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. description:
Head of Analytics | Last Mile | Hybrid Working | London OR Hatfield HQ

Introduction

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

As the Head of Analytics for Last Mile, you will take full ownership of the insight agenda for one of the most operationally intensive domains at Ocado. Last Mile oversees the critical final stage of our operation - ensuring the right orders reach the right customers on time - and encompasses delivery routing, fleet operations, slot management, and performance tracking across our global partners.

This is a highly influential, cross-functional position sitting on the Data & Analytics leadership team. While our underlying AI capability is already advanced, this role is less about inventing the technology and heavily focused on the human and operational element: turning advanced capabilities into tangible business value, driving stakeholder adoption, and bringing together teams that do not normally work closely together.

You will drive delivery through influence rather than direct authority, collaborating closely with VP-level leaders across Product, Engineering, and Partner Success, as well as peer Heads of Analytics in Fulfilment and Ecommerce. Additionally, you will ensure solutions are built in a way that serves Ocado Retail today, with a view to potentially releasing successful solutions to external Ocado partners in the future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Last-Mile Efficiency: Conceptualize opportunities, develop strategic approaches, and pull together the right cross-functional teams to optimize current operations.
  • Deliver Operational Value: Drive initiatives focused on turning advanced analytical/AI capabilities into operational reality, including improving store operations, maximizing fulfillment efficiency, and optimizing the use of chiller totes and capacity.
  • Enable Better Decision-Making: Enable a higher volume of orders to be successfully fulfilled through better operational and data-driven decisions.
  • Lead and Develop the Team: Manage the Last Mile analytics team, establishing clear standards for work prioritization, scoping, and communication.
  • Nurture Talent: Oversee the technical and communication development of analysts to ensure insights are actionable, highly impactful, and easily understood by the business.
  • Foster an Experimentation Culture: Champion a culture of innovation and experimentation, negotiating decision rights, setting clear evidence standards, and encouraging testing over instinctual decision-making.
  • Manage AI Foundations: Own the semantic and context layers for Last Mile, ensuring business definitions and metric logic remain accurate so AI-generated outputs align seamlessly with real-world operations.
  • Optimise Feedback Loops: Work with the central AI enablement function to design and maintain tight feedback loops between AI outputs and ground truth, helping stakeholders adopt and use these tools confidently.

What We're Looking For:

Essential
  • Complex Stakeholder Management & Influence: A background in management consultancy or a similarly complex multi-stakeholder environment. Proven ability to operate in complex environments, structure ambiguous problems, create alignment around a shared vision, and comfortably challenge existing thinking at a senior/VP level.
  • Influence Without Authority: Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of driving change and bringing together disparate teams through pure influence rather than direct reporting lines.
  • High Energy & Change Leadership: Energetic, charismatic, and collaborative mindset with experience leading an analytics or change function through substantive operational methodology shifts.
  • Tech & AI Landscape Literacy: A strong, grounded understanding of current AI tools and data platforms. The ability to distinguish genuinely useful solutions from noise and successfully translate complex AI/data capabilities into commercial, operational business value.
  • Analytical Foundations: Solid analytical foundations necessary to set team standards for experimentation, metric architecture, and validating model efficacy alongside Data Science partners.
Nice to Haves
  • Domain Familiarity: Experience within operational, logistics, or last-mile environments, bringing strong real-world context to data analysis (highly valued, but a nice-to-have rather than essential).
  • Data Science Exposure: History of working alongside data science or machine learning functions, understanding how to bridges analytics and operational modeling.
  • Modern Data Tooling Experience: Exposure to semantic layer tooling, data cataloguing, or AI evaluation frameworks.

Benefits: 

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

Time to recharge:

  • 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more – and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.

Health & wellbeing:

  • Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.

Family-first policies:

  • 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave

Financial support:

  • Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE), and interest-free loans for train tickets.

Commuter perks:

  • Cycle to Work Scheme and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.

Exclusive discounts:

  • 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month).

Be bold, be unique, be brilliant, be you. We are looking for individuality and we value diversity. We are an equal opportunities employer and we are committed to treating all applicants and employees fairly and equally. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive work environment. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application.

description: 🚀 Rejoignez une institution d’excellence et d’innovation en tant qu’Ingénieur(e) de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle appliquée à la vision 3D et au contrôle dimensionnel industriel - CDD 24 mois. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. 🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de recherche en intelligence artificielle appliquée à la vision industrielle 3D, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche, innovation technologique et transfert vers l’industrie, affecté(e) au Centre Fayol de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne. Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol. Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. ✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. Au sein de ce centre de recherche pluridisciplinaire (plus de 80 personnes), reconnu pour son expertise en IA, systèmes cyber-physiques et sciences des données, vous contribuerez à des projets de R&D à fort impact pour l’industrie du futur. Le centre s’appuie notamment sur sa plateformes technologiques IT'M Factory et est un acteur-clé de l'enseignement et de l'innovation au sein de l’Institut Mines-Télécom. Dans le cadre du projet régional DIGIMAN3D, financé par la Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, ce recrutement vise à développer et expérimenter une solution de contrôle dimensionnel 3D en ligne, basée sur l’acquisition de données 3D et l’intelligence artificielle, pour le contrôle automatisé de pièces mécaniques de précision en conditions industrielles. Vos missions principales seront les suivantes : · Vous assurez le développement et l’adaptation d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle appliqués aux données 3D et aux nuages de points, notamment pour la segmentation géométrique, l’identification des surfaces et la sélection des données pertinentes pour la mesure. · Vous participez à la qualification des capteurs 3D et à la mise en place du banc d’essai expérimental, ainsi qu’aux campagnes d’acquisition et de caractérisation des données dans des environnements représentatifs des conditions industrielles. · Vous contribuez au développement d’une chaîne hybride associant intelligence artificielle et méthodes géométriques analytiques, afin d’améliorer la précision, la robustesse et la répétabilité des mesures dimensionnelles, avec un objectif de précision inférieur à 20 µm. · Vous participez à l’intégration et à l’évaluation des modèles développés sur banc d’essai, puis sur machine à commande numérique et en conditions réelles de production, en collaboration avec les partenaires du consortium. · Vous rendez compte de vos travaux par des rapports techniques, des résultats expérimentaux, des démonstrateurs fonctionnels et des interactions régulières avec les partenaires scientifiques et industriels du projet. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet, à interagir avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire dialoguer recherche, développement et application industrielle sera essentielle pour réussir. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes titulaire d’un : · Diplôme Bac +5 (école d’ingénieur ou master 2) en science de données, informatique, intelligence artificielle, traitement d’image. Et idéalement : · Avec une expérience de 1 à 3 ans dans le secteur de l’intelligence artificielle appliquée, notamment à des projets en vision par ordinateur, segmentation, ou détection d’anomalies. Et vous possédez : • Une expérience significative en développement d’algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle ou de vision par ordinateur. • Une expérience confirmée en programmation Python avec des bibliothèques IA (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV) • Une expertise avérée en apprentissage non supervisé ou auto-supervisé, détection d’anomalies • Une maîtrise de l’anglais technique (niveau B2 confirmé) Vos atouts supplémentaires : · Connaissances en intégration sur matériel industriel (edge computing, GPU, PC embarqué) · Intérêt pour la transfert technologique et l'impact industriel concret 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde. Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver : Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an Un soutien à l’intégration : indépendamment de la participation à nos projets de recherche, l’Institut Henri Fayol vous assure les moyens financiers pour présenter vos travaux à 1 conférence internationale et un stagiaire en soutien. Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems. Automate the revenue engine Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them. Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention. Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems. Integrate AI into real workflows Move AI beyond prototypes. Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work. Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products. Build, don’t just recommend You will personally implement what you design. Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration. You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation. Drive measurable commercial impact Technology is a means, not the outcome. Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity. You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result. Requirements You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better. German or another European language is a plus Bonus Points You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows. You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities. The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership. A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization. A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person. MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work. Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows Unsere Werte Why autarc? autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers. Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations. description: About Sine Engineering Sine Engineering builds the technology behind reliable drone autonomy, delivering communication, navigation, and control systems that enable coordinated multi-drone operations. More than 200 UAV manufacturers rely on our solutions, and our technology powers many of the interceptor operations active today. Through our dual-use platform, we support civilian innovation while helping democratic nations strengthen their technological advantage. Any drone. Any scale. Anywhere. Resilient communication, navigation, and coordination built for the age of autonomy. Our products have already proven their effectiveness in real combat conditions in Ukraine. Responsibilities Build and expand Sine Engineering's customer and partner network across Germany. Identify, engage, and develop strategic accounts across the defense, aerospace, UAV manufacturing, systems integration, robotics, electronics, telecommunications, RF, autonomy, and other related technology sectors. Own the full sales cycle, including market mapping, prospecting, qualification, discovery, technical evaluation, proposal development, negotiation, closing, and long-term account growth. Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, defense primes, technology partners, and relevant government-affiliated stakeholders. Build direct relationships with senior executives and C-level decision-makers while developing strong engagement across engineering, program management, and procurement functions. Position Sine Engineering effectively before formal procurement and tender processes begin. Lead customer discussions related to communication modules, GNSS-denied navigation systems, video links, embedded autonomy software, and integration opportunities. Coordinate technical evaluations, pilot projects, demonstrations, and integration discussions in collaboration with product and engineering teams. Prepare commercial proposals, pricing structures, contract documentation, and partnership models. Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, volume commitments, long-term agreements, and commercial frameworks. Maintain high standards of CRM management, pipeline tracking, revenue forecasting, and account planning in line with European business operations. Provide market intelligence regarding German defense procurement, competitors, customer requirements, funding priorities, and partnership opportunities. Represent Sine Engineering at industry events, trade shows, conferences, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe. Help establish scalable and repeatable sales processes for the German market and contribute to future team growth. Work closely with the Managing Director Germany to ensure commercial account ownership and local market representation remain aligned and complementary. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, strategic account management, or partnerships within a complex technical environment. Proven track record of managing full-cycle sales processes with enterprise, industrial, defense, aerospace, or technology customers. Strong understanding of long sales cycles, multi-stakeholder procurement processes, and complex commercial negotiations. Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into clear business and technical requirements. Experience collaborating closely with engineering, product, operations, legal, and executive leadership teams. Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive-level communication abilities. Ability to work independently, proactively creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound leads. Strong sense of ownership and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, scale-up environment. Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, collaborating with both a functional sales manager and a local managing director. Based in Munich or willing to travel there regularly. Willingness to travel frequently across Germany, Ukraine, and Europe. Nice to Have Experience in the defense, aerospace, UAV, robotics, telecommunications, RF, or deep-tech sectors. Experience building a market presence, territory, or sales function from an early stage. Experience working with international teams, particularly across Germany and Eastern Europe. Experience negotiating framework agreements and other long-term commercial partnerships. Why Join Us? If you're excited about building technology that shapes the future of drone autonomy and want your work to have a meaningful impact on defense and security, we'd love to hear from you. If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions, don't hesitate to apply. We're looking for people who share our drive to push the boundaries of what's possible and deliver technologies that make a real-world difference. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Nous recherchons un.e Lead Data Analytics expérimenté·e et motivé·e pour piloter notre pôle Data Commercial (appelées pod). Ce rôle est avant tout un rôle de partenaire business: tu comprendras en profondeur les enjeux des équipes Ventes, Marketing et Expérience Client, tu définiras avec elles les bons problèmes à résoudre, et tu traduiras ces besoins en solutions data à forte valeur ajoutée. Tu seras responsable de l’animation du pôle et garant·e de la qualité, de la pertinence métier et de l’impact des livrables. Tes missions seront les suivantes : Être un partenaire business des équipes Ventes, Marketing et Customer Experience : L’impact et l’agilité sont notre priorité: Initier et développer des projets data à impact fort en utilisant l’ensemble de la boîte à outils data (par exemple: segmentation client, cross-selling etc.) Faire grandir les usages: Accompagner le pôle et les équipes métier dans l’usage de l’IA et sa capacité à créer de la valeur réelle Animer et piloter le pôle Commercial : Définir la roadmap et la stratégie du pôle: Être un relais de la priorisation en lien avec les équipes, en s’assurant que chaque projet est délivré avec un impact mesurable Manager les membres de pôle Commercial: accompagner les membres de l’équipe, favoriser la collaboration et leur développement professionnel Assurer le développement technique: s’assurer de la qualité technique et de la clarté de la modélisation. Inciter l’équipe à utiliser l’ensemble de la boîte à outil data (ex.: IA, Machine Learning) en fonction de ce qui est pertinent Contribuer à la stratégie data en France et dans le groupe : Participer à la mutualisation: être un relais auprès des autres équipes et du groupe pour contribuer aux efforts de mutualisation Contribuer à l’animation data en général: participer à l’animation de la communauté data en France et dans le groupe Profil recherché : Expérience : Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en tant que Data Analyst ou Data Scientist, avec au moins 2 ans d'expérience en gestion d'équipe dans un contexte similaire Solide expérience dans l'analyse de données commerciales, la modélisation prédictive et la création de rapports. Parcours académique en statistiques / mathématique / économie, diplôme spécialisé en data, ou en école d’Ingénieur avec une forte appétence en Data Compétences techniques : Parfaite maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données (SQL, Python/R) et de la modélisation de données avec DBT Être à l’aise avec des outils visualisation de données Savoir utiliser l’IA au quotidien et à bon escient Connaissance du Machine Learning ou des algorithmes recommandés Compétences interpersonnelles : Fortes compétences en leadership, en mentorat et en développement d'équipe. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation. Capacité à traduire des concepts techniques complexes en termes simples pour un public non technique. Pensée analytique et résolution de problèmes, tu es moteur-rice dans ce que tu entreprends Langues : Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit pour interagir avec nos collègues internationaux. Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! description: Introduction to Role & Team At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes. What You’ll Do Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement. Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property. Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials. Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation. Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships. Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk. Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently. Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use. About You You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction. Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills. You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both. You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions. You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions. You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve. You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers. You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy. Benefits & Perks Annual personal learning & development budget Private Medical Insurance (PMI) Private Dental Insurance Babylon Health app Mental health support Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package Unlimited PTO Subsidised gym membership ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6% Premium App Access About Us Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products. AI Fluency AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes. We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us. Final Compensation Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations. Inclusion at Bumble Inc. Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc). AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly. description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role You design the mechanics of our robotic hands — from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production. Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline. You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO. What you will do: CAD design. Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release. Mechanism & kinematics. Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios. Calculation & validation. Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured. Material selection. Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions. Assembly design. Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling. Design for manufacturing. Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset — machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing — balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes. Prototyping & testing. Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause. Documentation & release. Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews. Suppliers & production. Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up. Cross-functional integration. Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system. What you bring: Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification. 5–10 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production. Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T. Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness. Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work. Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components. Practical DFM/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes. Hands-on mentality — you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself. Fluent in English and German. Bonus: Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms. Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration. Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures. Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures. Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation. Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About Okta for AI Agents

Okta secures access for 20,000 organizations and billions of users. Okta for AI Agents extends that work to the agentic shift. Deploying an AI agent is not like deploying traditional software. You are putting professional work output into production, and it needs deep integration, continuous tuning, and change management. Every agent needs an identity, a scope, an audit trail, and a way to be shut down when it goes wrong. Most enterprises have not built this yet. We are.

We hire builders who see the cracks in enterprise agent identity that everyone else has learned to live with.

The Role

You are the most senior technical field authority for agent identity at Okta. Where a Senior FDE owns the outcome inside one account, you own the patterns that every account and every FDE inherits. You take the hardest and most strategic deployments yourself, set the reference architecture the team builds from, and turn what the field learns into the direction the product takes.

You still write code. You also multiply the people around you, and you are the person product and engineering leadership call when an agent identity problem has no precedent.

Responsibilities

  • Own the reference architecture. Define the canonical agent identity, delegation, audit, and kill-switch patterns that Senior FDEs deploy across the portfolio, and keep them current as the standards and the product move.
  • Lead the hardest accounts. Personally own the most strategic, regulated, or technically novel deployments, the ones where there is no playbook yet.
  • Raise the technical bar. Review other FDEs’ architectures, coach senior customer engineers and your own team, and set the standard for what good looks like in the field.
  • Shape the roadmap. Synthesize patterns across every account into a clear point of view, and work directly with product and engineering leadership to prioritize what ships next.
  • Represent Okta as a technical authority. Brief CISO, CIO, and Chief AI Officer audiences, contribute to the standards and frameworks shaping agent identity, and carry the external technical voice.
  • Resolve what others cannot. Step into the hardest technical and political situations across accounts and find the path forward.
  • Set the standard for evals and observability. Define how the team measures authorization latency, scope sprawl, delegation anomalies, audit completeness, and kill-switch verification, so it scales beyond any single customer.
  • Build the team’s leverage. Turn recurring field work into reusable modules, internal tooling, and enablement so the whole FDE function moves faster.

Requirements

  • Engineering depth. 10+ years shipping production software, with deep distributed systems and identity experience and a track record of staying hands-on while setting direction.
  • Authority-level identity protocols. OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, RFC 8693 token exchange, act claims, CIMD and DCR, DPoP. Contribution to standards or open source is a plus.
  • Deep agent security fluency. OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, plus MCP, A2A, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act, with the judgment to apply them in HIPAA, FedRAMP, and SOC 2 environments.
  • Expert fine-grained authorization. ReBAC and ABAC with policy engines (OPA, Cedar, OpenFGA, or equivalent), and command of the design tradeoffs at scale.
  • Proven AI hands-on. Production integrations across the major agent platforms and MCP, and daily AI-native development.
  • Force multiplier. A record of setting technical direction across multiple teams or accounts, and of mentoring senior engineers.
  • Customer-facing authority. Credible from the IDE to the boardroom, trusted by CISOs and principal engineers alike, and steady when account politics get sharp.
  • High agency, founder’s mindset. Applied to building a function, not just an account.
  • Ability to travel, on occasion, up to 35%

We're bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing – and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy – and we know we can't shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.

What we do
RELEX Solutions delivers a unified supply chain planning platform for retailers and manufacturers, enabled by proven AI technology. We help companies optimize demand forecasting, replenishment, merchandising, pricing and promotions, supply chain operations, and production planning across the end-to-end value chain.

With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, we work side-by-side with our customers to solve real problems with lasting impact. Companies trust RELEX to increase product availability, boost sales, deliver actionable insights, improve sustainability, and drive profitable growth. Join us and make an impact on the world and your career!

In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we're looking for experienced Product Engineers to join our Supply Chain product teams: people who thrive at the intersection of customer problems, technical solutions, and business strategy, and who want to own outcomes from discovery through production.

What we need you to do and be
Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.

  • Own requirements end-to-end for your product area, from discovery through UAT and quality assurance, making sure what ships solves the real underlying problem, not just the stated ask.
  • Own your deployed product and iterate fast: manage releases, gather structured customer feedback, and feed it back into the next iteration.
  • Work closely with your Engineering Manager to translate customer needs and usage data into team-level priorities, keeping the roadmap grounded in real outcomes.
  • Act as an industry and product expert in customer-facing settings, pushing back on stated requirements when the evidence points elsewhere, and supporting sales efforts such as scoping and feasibility.
  • Validate that solutions genuinely meet customer expectations through ongoing quality gates and proactive expectation management.

What you'll bring to the table
Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don't make sense. We stop doing what doesn't add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.

  • Deep understanding of your customers' day-to-day work, goals, and pain points across an entire product area.
  • Confidence to push back on stated customer needs when evidence points to a different solution, and experience mentoring other Product Engineers.
  • Experience designing solutions to complex problems spanning data, AI/ML, UX, and system integration.
  • Solid software engineering and DevOps skills, building and deploying solutions using RELEX's existing frameworks.
  • Comfortable with using AI in your everyday work and developing the use of AI tools as a larger organizational strategy.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • As a bonus, we consider experience working with an international team, plus great communication and organizational skills.

What we offer in return
You'll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.

  • An international career and learning opportunities
  • A rapidly growing and financially robust software company with exciting opportunities for career growth, also in the future
  • Flexibility in how and where you work
  • Room to thrive in a fast-growing global company with a good market position
  • Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
  • Annual leave
  • Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
  • Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
  • Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
  • Two paid volunteering days each year
  • Real leadership development paths, a genuine range of roles across product areas, continued investment in the team, and hands-on exposure to new technologies including agentic engineering

If this is the opportunity you don't want to miss, apply by sending your cover letter and resume through the application form as soon as possible.

Please note that to be considered for this position, you must be based in one of our office locations and hold a valid work permit for your location. We're excited to connect with applicants who meet these criteria and share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what's next for the product, the planet, and the people.

Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!

title: Regional Sales Director (m/w/d) – Vertriebsleitung Region Süd

description:
Du willst kein Gebiet verwalten. Du willst ein Team bauen, das auch ohne dich verkauft. Als Regional Sales Director führst du acht Leute im Außendienst zwischen Ulm, Augsburg und München, mit KI-basierter Lead-Priorisierung, eigenem Forecast und Key-Account-Verhandlungen, die du selbst zum Abschluss bringst.

 

Standort: Großraum München – du arbeitest eigenständig in der Region Süd im Außendienst, mit rund 60 % Kundenterminen und 40 % Homeoffice, langfristig eher 50/50.

 

Über uns

CarOnSale ist die KI-gestützte Plattform für den B2B-Gebrauchtwagenhandel in Europa. Über 40.000 Käufer aus mehr als 20 Ländern handeln auf unserer Plattform – und 85 % des Inventars ist exklusiv bei uns. Wir verbinden Software, Pricing-Intelligenz, Logistik und Finanzierung in einer Schicht – als Betriebssystem für eine ganze Branche.

One Platform. One Profit Engine.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust das regionale Field-Sales-Team weiter auf und etablierst eine Leistungskultur, in der jede Person ihre Zahlen selbst verantwortet
  • Du entwickelst eine hybride Vertriebsstrategie, die digitale Tools mit persönlicher Kundennähe verbindet
  • Du implementierst klar strukturierte Vertriebsprozesse mit definierten Rollen
  • Du setzt die regionalen Wachstumsziele um und führst strategische Key-Account-Verhandlungen bis zum Abschluss
  • Du steuerst den Vertriebserfolg datengetrieben über KPIs, Forecasts und KI-basierte Lead-Priorisierung
  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Customer Journey und hebst Produktivität, Effizienz und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Du präsentierst deine Ergebnisse in KPI-Dashboards und Business Reviews auf Führungsebene

 

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Führungserfahrung mit einem Vertriebsteam von mehr als sechs Personen
  • Erfahrung im Außendienst sowie im Hunting- und Farming-Modell
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger, komplexer Produkte – du überzeugst mit Argumenten und gibst dieses Wissen an dein Team weiter
  • Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und Performance-Coaching, mit operativer Nähe zum Tagesgeschäft
  • KPIs, Forecasts und datengetriebene Steuerung sind für dich selbstverständlich, ebenso der Umgang mit Salesforce, Google Workspace, Looker oder Tableau
  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B2 für die Zusammenarbeit im Führungsteam

Von Vorteil

  • Verständnis für skalierbare Vertriebsmodelle in digitalen Umfeldern, idealerweise Start-up, SaaS oder Plattform
  • KI-gestützte Sales-Prozesse hast du nicht nur kennengelernt, sondern aktiv mitgestaltet

 

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung inklusive Tankkarte
  • 28 Tage Urlaub
  • 2× jährliches Karriere- & Entwicklungsgespräch
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Dienstrad-Leasing zur privaten Nutzung
  • FitX-Mitgliedschaft oder Urban Sports Club-Zuschuss
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterangebote und Vergünstigungen
  • Virtual Stock Options – du beteiligst dich am Erfolg
  • Moderne IT-Ausstattung für dein tägliches Arbeiten
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Buddy-Programm und Social Events
  • Gelebte Vielfalt: aktives Frauennetzwerk

 

Bewirb dich jetzt – dein Lebenslauf reicht.

description: We are looking for an experienced AI Application Engineer to design and build intelligent applications powered by LLMs, LangGraph, and modern agentic AI technologies. You will focus on transforming business requirements into AI applications capable of reasoning through tasks, retrieving information, interacting with tools and enterprise systems, requesting human approval when required, and completing business processes. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, software development, workflow automation, and business process transformation. Requirements Agentic AI Application Development Design and develop AI applications using LangGraph and LLM technologies. Build agents capable of executing complex, multi-step business processes. Design stateful workflows incorporating reasoning, tool usage, validation, approvals, and exception handling. Develop single-agent and multi-agent solutions where appropriate. Translate business requirements into practical agentic AI architectures. LLM Application Engineering Integrate LLMs into production applications. Develop prompt strategies, structured outputs, tool calling, and context-management approaches. Select appropriate models based on accuracy, capability, latency, security, and cost. Develop mechanisms to improve reliability and reduce hallucinations. Implement appropriate guardrails around AI-generated decisions and actions. RAG and Enterprise Knowledge Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions. Connect AI applications to enterprise documents, databases, APIs, and knowledge repositories. Develop retrieval and ranking strategies to provide agents with relevant context. Work with embeddings and vector databases. Implement data and context pipelines supporting AI agents. Business Process Automation Analyse business processes and identify opportunities for agentic automation. Design AI workflows that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic business logic. Build agents capable of retrieving information, making decisions, invoking tools, and completing actions. Implement human-in-the-loop approval and escalation processes. Ensure automated actions are controlled, auditable, and reversible where appropriate. Evaluation and Quality Develop evaluation frameworks for AI applications and agent workflows. Define metrics covering accuracy, task completion, reliability, latency, and cost. Build automated tests for prompts, agents, tools, and end-to-end workflows. Analyse failures and continuously improve agent behaviour. Use observability and evaluation data to optimise production systems. Production Deployment Deploy and operate AI applications in cloud and enterprise environments. Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and performance management. Design resilient workflows with retries, timeouts, fallbacks, and recovery mechanisms. Work with DevOps and platform teams to establish appropriate deployment and CI/CD practices. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with product managers, business analysts, software engineers, data scientists, architects, and business stakeholders. Communicate AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and implementation options. Help organisations identify realistic and valuable use cases for agentic AI. Required Experience Commercial experience developing AI/LLM applications. Hands-on experience with LangGraph and agentic workflow development. Strong Python development experience. Experience deploying AI applications into production. Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, tool calling, structured outputs, and prompt engineering. Experience integrating AI applications with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, or SaaS platforms. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with AI evaluation, monitoring, and observability.
